Type: glass geometric terrarium lantern

Style: modern, glam, contemporary
Materials: clear glass panels, gold-finished metal frame
Colors: clear, warm gold

Feel: airy, elegant, graphic
Goes with: white walls, marble, brass accents, greenery; modern or glam rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Glass Diamond Candle Holder Lantern Terrarium Decor - 6.25 Inch, Gold-Finished Trim
product.description: This gold-trimmed glass candle holder brings elegance along with light to a dining room. Its irregular shape adds an edgy modern twist. Alternatively, fill it with silk flowers or holiday ornaments. Even empty, it's a charming standalone piece. 8.75"D x 8.75"W x 15"H Use as a decorative item by itself or with a candle Wipe with soft damp cloth
